blockers.title: The artifact offers a preview disposition as DR-117's successor — the exact move DR-117's own recorded candidate exists to refuse — and duplicates an already-recorded preview disposition of the same seven items without stating either relation
blockers.finding: Two artifacts already occupy this ground and the subject engages neither. First, D-068 recorded product-boundary-preview.v2 (ff7a0913, documentClass PRODUCT-DISPOSITION-CANDIDATE, scope 'architecture preview (D-002 / D-018) only') as, in D-068's own words, 'the preview-scope product disposition of file 02's seven binding items (PB-1..PB-6 EXCLUDED, PB-7 NOT REPLACED)', and that recording states expressly that it 'Does not close DR-117 or DR-011-R16'. The subject's dispositions are the same shape — six NOs and one PARTIAL/NOT-REPLACED over the same seven items — under a different name. Second, D-116 recorded product-boundary-successor-contract.v8 (52c70f77, 26,730 bytes) as DR-117's accepted design-contract successor candidate, and v8's stated purpose is: 'Give DR-117 a reviewable T2-02 candidate that extracts the seven items by verbatim carry and refuses silent succession from preview.' The subject's previewReadAs says 'For the D-002 preview, the successor is this artifact's seven dispositions' — which is succession from preview, the move v8 was authored to refuse and which D-068's recording had already separated from DR-117's closure. Measured in the subject: v8 appears once and preview.v2 once, both only inside authorityClaim's not-SATISFIED disclaimer; D-116 and D-068 appear zero times; there is no basedOn or lineage field of any kind. So a third artifact enters a row that already holds a recorded candidate and a recorded preview disposition, with no statement of whether it supersedes v8, complements it, restates preview.v2, or is subordinate to either.
blockers.whyBlocking: DR-117's row would carry two candidates with no stated precedence, and the corpus's recorded distinction between a preview disposition and DR-117's succession — drawn at D-068, restated at D-116, and built into v8's purpose — would be blurred by an artifact that neither cites nor engages it. Every other contract in this corpus carries its lineage: the provider-only chain pinned each predecessor by path and digest with the relation stated. This one carries none.
blockers.repair: Add a lineage block pinning product-boundary-successor-contract.v8 by path and digest and product-boundary-preview.v2 by path and digest, and state the relation to each in terms: whether this artifact is a preview-scoped complement that leaves v8 the T2-02 candidate for DR-117's general succession, or a successor to v8, or a restatement of preview.v2's already-recorded disposition. Then reconcile previewReadAs with v8's refusal clause — either drop the claim that these dispositions are 'the successor' and describe them as the preview-scoped disposition that does not effect succession, or state on what authority preview succession is now permitted where v8 and D-068 hold it is not.

blockers.title: Item 4's name is truncated to drop 'and required enforcement evidence', and the cell's enforcement-evidence limb is answered by a single clause that routes it to the wrong condition and contradicts the artifact's own item-4 disposition
blockers.finding: File 02's item 4, extracted programmatically from the live bytes, reads 'untrusted native or WASM admission and required enforcement evidence'. The subject names it 'untrusted native or WASM admission' and dispositions only the admission half: 'NO. DR-128 stays post-MVP. Fault containment (DR-G21) is not a sandbox.' That disposition is itself good — it names the right post-MVP home and correctly refuses to treat DR-G21 as confinement, matching DR-G21's own row — but it says nothing about required enforcement evidence, and the truncated name conceals that anything is missing. This matters because enforcement evidence is not incidental to this row: DR-117's acceptance cell, quoted verbatim by the subject itself, is 'Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3 with enforcement evidence', and DR-010's cell likewise requires 'trust and enforcement evidence'. The subject's only sentence on the topic is in registerRowQuoted.previewReadAs: 'Enforcement evidence for confinement/marketplace remains condition 4 / post-preview.' Measured against the register, that home is wrong. DR-128's acceptance-evidence cell carries 'demonstrated OS/WASM enforcement, permission/platform matrix, escape tests, revocation and incident ownership', and DR-128's status is 'OPEN — deferred post-MVP by recorded scope' — a condition-2 row on the deferral limb, not condition 4. The clause therefore also contradicts the subject's own item 4, which names DR-128. The word 'enforcement' occurs exactly once in the whole artifact, and no evidence class of any kind is offered, though the corpus supplies the obvious preview-scoped one: v1-slice §7 item 8 requires that a PlanIntent containing an excluded form be rejected during request validation with the required typed outcome, creating no ExecutionId, AttemptRecord, ExecutionPlan or authoritative Run.
blockers.whyBlocking: The acceptance cell has two limbs and the second is the one the artifact both mis-names and mis-routes. A successor that answers 'explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3' while leaving 'with enforcement evidence' to a single sentence pointing at the wrong condition has not answered the cell, and the truncated item name means a reader comparing the seven dispositions to file 02 would not notice.
blockers.repair: Restore item 4's full name and disposition both halves: admission NO, and required enforcement evidence not owed in the preview because nothing untrusted is admitted, with the obligation attaching to DR-128's post-MVP successor — naming DR-128 rather than condition 4, consistently with item 4's own text. Then give the cell's second limb a preview-scoped answer rather than a deferral: state the enforcement evidence the preview does carry, which is the excluded-form admission refusal v1-slice §7 item 8 already specifies, and say whether a retained negative-test class is owed for it.

distanceToAccept.assessment: Both blockers are about placement rather than substance. The seven dispositions themselves are defensible and match file 12 §5 and D-068's already-recorded shape; what is missing is the artifact's relationship to the two artifacts already recorded on this ground, and a real answer to the acceptance cell's enforcement-evidence limb. Neither repair requires rewriting the dispositions.
distanceToAccept.sharpestQuestionForTheAuthor: If product-boundary-preview.v2 is already the recorded preview-scope disposition of these same seven items, and v8 is already DR-117's recorded candidate whose stated purpose is refusing succession from preview, what does this artifact add that those two do not, and under what authority does it effect the succession they withhold?

coordinatorSummary: REJECT at 2 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Sixteen attacks run, four landed. Custody is intact: subject 50cb8c71 at 0444 unmoved and valid JSON, HEAD never left d204ba0, file 08 and file 02 at their pins with a clean tree. Much of the artifact is careful — both sources pinned and reproducing, the acceptance cell quoted byte-for-byte, the D-011 count pin carried with its re-open consequence, six of seven item names exact or differing only in punctuation, every exclusion a plain NO with a named basis, item 7 covering all seven of file 12 §5's bullets including the sidecar-deferred-not-abandoned and independent-release-preserved clauses, and the DR-131 pack referenced with nothing invented. Five of the prompt's seven attack classes are refuted outright. What blocks is placement. First, two artifacts already occupy this ground and the subject engages neither: D-068 recorded product-boundary-preview.v2 as the preview-scope product disposition of these same seven binding items, PB-1..PB-6 EXCLUDED and PB-7 NOT REPLACED — the same shape as this subject — and expressly held that it does not close DR-117; and D-116 recorded product-boundary-successor-contract.v8 as DR-117's accepted candidate, whose stated purpose is to extract the seven items by verbatim carry and refuse silent succession from preview. This subject's previewReadAs says the preview successor is its seven dispositions, which is that succession. Measured: v8 and preview.v2 appear once each, only in a not-SATISFIED disclaimer; D-116 and D-068 appear zero times; there is no lineage field at all, in a corpus where every contract pins its predecessor. Second, file 02's item 4 is 'untrusted native or WASM admission and required enforcement evidence' and the subject names only the admission half, dispositioning only that half; the acceptance cell it quotes is 'Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3 with enforcement evidence', and the single sentence addressing that limb routes it to condition 4 when DR-128 carries the OS/WASM enforcement evidence as a condition-2 row on the deferral limb — contradicting the subject's own item 4, which names DR-128 correctly. 'Enforcement' occurs once in the artifact and no evidence class is offered, though v1-slice §7 item 8 supplies the natural preview-scoped one. Both repairs are additive; the dispositions themselves need not change.
